_notice: FICTITIOUS. Two websites for a product that does not exist. The domains use .example; the pages, job codes and dates are invented.
usage: Every version of the QUORVANTA HCP site and consumer site from launch to the as_of date, with the full text of each page. A page is a list of units. {"ref": "PIECE/UNIT"} is a unit of promotional/promo-materials.json word for word; {"claim": id} is an HCP claim's text and {"dtc": id} a consumer claim's text from patient/dtc-claims.json, word for word; any other unit carries its own text, with the claims that support it when it makes a statement about the product. Retired versions cite claims as they then stood: SUP-002 described only the bottle of 120 before the starter bottle. isi is the panel shown at the foot of every page of that version. Each version is one promotional material, with its own job code, filed on Form FDA 2253 (regulatory/opdp-submissions.json); a version with no filing declares the breach in deviations. population/portal-sessions.json records visits to the HCP site. regulatory/hcp-website.md and consumer-website.md are generated from this file by scripts/render.py.
